about_the_game:
Trapped in a prison that bends reality itself, Chapter II: Neuromare takes you on a mind-twisting journey where nothing is as it seems. With no guards in sight, the true chains that bind you are the ones you cannot see. Pillboy, your eccentric and deceptive guide, will lead you through a maze of illusions, half-truths, and outright trolling. Every clue is a test, every path a trick—can you separate the real from the fake and break free from the madness?

Prepare for a psychological labyrinth where overthinking is your greatest enemy. Escape is possible, but at what cost?
